entries.original: **Removed the team MCP bridge** (#4788). The `oh-my-claude-sisyphus/team` package export and its MCP server bridge are gone, because nothing spawned them. Use the `team` skill or the `omc team` command surface instead.
entries.translated: **team MCP 브릿지 제거** (#4788). 실행 주체가 없어 `oh-my-claude-sisyphus/team` 패키지 export와 MCP 서버 브릿지를 삭제했습니다. 대신 `team` 스킬이나 `omc team` 커맨드 인터페이스를 사용하세요.

entries.original: **feat(jev): calibrated five-level effort for model-routing** (#4850), building on **model-routing choosing subagent effort** (#4810) and **an effort range in model-routing** (#4820)
entries.translated: **model-routing을 위한 5단계 노력 수준(effort) 보정** (#4850). model-routing의 서브에이전트 노력 수준 선택(#4810) 및 model-routing의 노력 범위 설정(#4820) 기능을 기반으로 구축되었습니다.

entries.original: **feat(skills): pstack suites**: PR-care (#4579), panel/generator/utility (#4589), principles and benchmark-checklist (#4592), review-and-climb, statechart (TLA+ model checking) and ketchup-video (#4840), plus pstack wording-drift syncs (#4841, #4849)
